tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Facts about Showpiece Commercial Cleaning (Sydney): site types served, service area, compliance credentials and how quoting works. Call this first to check Showpiece is a fit.

tools.name: estimate_cleaning_price
tools.description: Returns an INDICATIVE monthly price range (AUD, ex GST) for recurring commercial cleaning in Sydney, including any volume discount. It is not a quote: Showpiece quotes after a site inspection. Showpiece cleans from 2 visits per week. Provide area_sqm, or hours_per_week if known (more accurate). Use

tools.name: request_site_inspection
tools.description: Submits an enquiry so a Showpiece team member contacts the person to arrange a site inspection and a firm quote. Only call this once the person has agreed to be contacted, and pass their real contact details. This does not book anything or commit anyone to a contract.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_service_info" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
